about: Held-out set: 10 CaptainCook4D recordings from two recipes the development set does not use. Chosen and label-checked after the decision rules were frozen at commit 9c1269e, and committed before being run. Labels were checked by eye the same way as the development set (proofstep.datasets.label_sheets). Recordings were the shortest of each recipe, mixing ones with skipped steps, steps out of order, and none.

recordings.notes: Eggs go into a bowl rather than a ramekin. No cooking spray appears anywhere.
Starts with the egg, microwaves and stirs it, then pours oil on afterwards (its order mistakes).
Only one microwave run (2:35-3:45), after whisking. The labels call it S5 and S3 skipped; calling it S3 with S5 skipped would be just as defensible.
Replaces 1_34. No cooking spray appears anywhere.
No bread appears anywhere: the result is an egg custard.
The bread is cut but stays on the board; only the egg goes on the plate.
Replaces 9_45, the only French toast recording with an order mistake.

excluded.reason: Camera points at the microwave and cabinets; the counter is barely in frame (same person and kitchen as 7_30).
Same camera problem as 1_34 and 7_30 (person 6, kitchen 10).
